_comment: One spoken quip per story for the week's Reel (scripts/ig-reel.py). Real spellings; the script applies the LEXICON's TTS respellings itself. Keep each under about fifteen words — it is said and shown.
intro: Sixteen things in South Knoxville this weekend. Quick, before they sell out.
outro: That's the weekend. The whole briefing is at soknoear.com. Link in bio.

quips.old-sevier-market-opens: The grocery store with onions in it opens Saturday at seven. Sevier Avenue finally has one.
quips.scruffy-roots-fest: Six Americana acts on the Kern's lawn Sunday, free. Bring a chair.
quips.knox-ill: Graffiti writers paint Printshop live for twelve hours Saturday. There's a lager brewed for it.
quips.urban-wilderness-50k: Thirty-one miles through seven parks, Saturday at seven thirty. Expect runners on the trails.
quips.oakenfold-sold-out: Paul Oakenfold sold out The 808 Thursday, a week after the place opened.
quips.dj-goblin-alliance: A DJ called Goblin turns Alliance Brewing into a dance floor Thursday at eight.
quips.feral-kitty-release: Feral Kitty lets its new music out of the box Friday night at Fly by Night.
quips.dizzle-phunk: Saturday night a new DJ, Dizzle Phunk, keeps Fly by Night dancing till one.
quips.after-brunch-special: Six comics for five dollars at the Pink Cactus, Saturday at two thirty.
quips.trailhead-kimbro: Daniel Kimbro's upright bass on the Trailhead patio, Friday at seven.
quips.trailhead-two-heads: Two Heads Are Better Than One close the weekend at Trailhead, Sunday at four.
quips.big-day-birding: Count the fall migrants with a naturalist at Ijams Nature Center, Saturday at eight.
quips.storytime-flowers: Free flower storytime at the Nature Playscape, Saturday at ten.
quips.kerns-second-mural: Anna Charney is painting wildflowers on the back of Kern's. Free to watch, any day.
quips.vegan-bbq-printshop: Southern Fried Vegan smokes a barbecue pop-up at Printshop, Sunday one to four.
quips.specials-board: Earl's game-day board for the Vols: two dollars off drafts, buckets at six for five.
